---
title: "About SixtyEight95"
---

SixtyEight95 looks at everyday costs (gas, housing, groceries) using real public data.
Every post shows its sources, and every projection shows how sure it is.

## Why the name?

In statistics, the **68-95-99.7 rule** says that about 68% of outcomes fall close to the average,
95% a bit further out, and 99.7% almost everywhere. It's a reminder that a good number always comes
with a range. We try to bring that same honesty to the numbers that hit your wallet.

## Data sources

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED, and other public
datasets named in each post.
